steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: A client wants extra work in the middle of a job. Here's how to write a change order.

steps.caption: Open the job
steps.narration: On the Pipeline, find the job and open it.

steps.caption: Revised contract
steps.narration: Revised contract is the job's price, and it says how much of that is change orders.

steps.caption: An approved change order
steps.narration: This job already has one, and the client has approved it.

steps.caption: Title
steps.narration: To add another, type a title that says what's changing.

steps.caption: Extra days
steps.narration: Days is how much longer the job will take. This one adds a day.

steps.caption: Add
steps.narration: Choose the plus button to add it.

steps.caption: A draft with its number
steps.narration: The change order gets its own number, and starts as a draft.

steps.caption: Mark sent & copy link
steps.narration: Mark sent and copy link marks it sent, and copies the client's approval link for you to share.

steps.selector: text=An approved CO adjusts the contract value and the schedule together.
steps.caption: Approved: contract and schedule adjust
steps.narration: Once the client approves, the contract value and the schedule adjust together.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: You'll find your jobs under Pipeline in the menu.

youtube.title: How to write a change order | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of change orders in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a job from the Pipeline, add a change order with its amount and extra days on the Change orders tab, and see where to mark it sent and copy the client's approval link.
